reason: Conversation 1 asked the right diagnostic questions (electrical vs food smell, inside vs rear) which surfaced the hot-plastic smell, flicker and crackle, then issued a correct stop/isolate instruction with appropriate escalation to an electrician or engineer; its only weaknesses were not asking about the cooker switch and slightly over-committing to 'most likely a terminal block'. Conversation 2 jumped straight to a boilerplate stop warning on 'funny smell' with no questions, never learning whether this was electrical or just residue, and gave no diagnosis or specific escalation. Both reached the safe outcome, but 1 did so with honest, efficient reasoning rather than a blind reflex.
